extension_description.message: Automatically sorts tabs that aren't in a group of your own into 9 groups (today, yesterday, … last year) by when they were opened or — an option in Settings — when they were last used, and moves them on after midnight. In Settings you can also add groups from bookmarks: tabs bookmarked in a chosen folder (optionally also any address on the bookmark's domain) get a group of their own. Automatic groups stay to the right of your own groups, from oldest to newest.

tabGroups_description.message: Automatically sorts tabs that aren't in a group of your own into 9 groups (today, yesterday, … last year) by when they were opened or — an option in Settings — when they were last used, and moves them on after midnight. In Settings you can also add groups from bookmarks: tabs bookmarked in a chosen folder (optionally also any address on the bookmark's domain) get a group of their own. Automatic groups stay to the right of your own groups, from oldest to newest.

tabGroups_setting_group_by_opened.message: when the tab was opened — a tab stays in the group of the day it was opened

tabGroups_setting_group_by_last_used.message: when the tab was last used — a tab you switch to moves to the "today" group

tabGroups_setting_manual_moves.message: Allow dragging tabs between automatic groups — a tab dragged into another day's group (e.g. from "today" to "yesterday") stays there (when sorting by last use, until you switch to it again)

tabGroups_setting_title_prefix.message: Prefix before the names of all automatic groups (groups from bookmarks too), separated by a space — empty = no prefix

tabGroups_setting_groups.message: Automatic tab groups (name, color and collapsed group for each period)

tabGroups_setting_bookmark_groups.message: Groups from bookmarks (group name, bookmark folder, whole-domain option, color and collapsed group)

tabGroups_intro_opened.message: $1: tabs outside your own groups are sorted into groups automatically by when they were opened.

tabGroups_intro_last_used.message: $1: tabs outside your own groups are sorted into groups automatically by when they were last used.

tabGroups_intro_opened_bookmarks.message: $1: tabs outside your own groups are sorted into groups automatically by when they were opened, and bookmarked tabs in the chosen folders into groups from bookmarks.

tabGroups_intro_last_used_bookmarks.message: $1: tabs outside your own groups are sorted into groups automatically by when they were last used, and bookmarked tabs in the chosen folders into groups from bookmarks.

tabGroups_unsupported.message: This browser doesn't let extensions manage tab groups (Chrome 89+, Firefox 139+ on desktop).

tabGroups_missing_permission.message: Tab groups permission is missing — nothing is being sorted yet.

tabGroups_missing_alarms.message: Without the alarms permission, groups move on after midnight only the next time you work with tabs.

tabGroups_missing_bookmarks.message: Groups from bookmarks need access to bookmarks and tab addresses — they aren't used yet.

tabGroups_identify_title.message: Groups the module manages automatically briefly blink in all windows

tabGroups_overview_elsewhere.message: The window's group overview is in the popup, side panel or Settings.

tabGroups_overview_not_sorted.message: Tabs in this window haven't been sorted yet — try "Regroup now".

tabGroups_overview_no_groups.message: There's no automatic group in this window yet (tabs are in your own groups or pinned).

tabGroups_user_groups.message: Your own groups to the left of them: $1

tabGroups_no_response.message: The module's background part didn't respond — try reloading the extension.

tabGroups_nothing_to_regroup.message: All tabs are already in the right group.

tabGroups_identified_one.message: $1 group managed by the module blinked (in all windows).

tabGroups_identified_other.message: $1 groups managed by the module blinked (in all windows).

tabGroups_identified_none.message: The module currently manages no group.

tabGroups_problem_disabled.message: The module is disabled or not in the module list — tabs aren't being sorted.

tabGroups_bookmarks_describe_domain.message: on the domains of bookmarks in the "$1" folder

tabGroups_editor_hint.message: Tabs that aren't in a group of your own are sorted into a period group automatically by when they were opened or when they were last used (option above). The module recognizes its groups by name — don't give any of your own groups the same name.

tabGroups_editor_duplicates.message: Group names must not repeat ($1) — a repeated name is saved as the period's default name.

tabGroups_editor_collapsed_title.message: A new group is created collapsed — but if it contains the currently open tab, it stays expanded so the browser doesn't switch elsewhere. The module never collapses or expands an existing group.

tabGroups_bookmarks_hint.message: A tab whose address is bookmarked in the chosen folder (including subfolders) goes into the group from bookmarks instead of a period group; the whole address is compared, without the part after #. If a tab belongs to several groups, the first row wins. Groups from bookmarks sit in the tab bar between your own groups and the periods.

tabGroups_bookmarks_duplicates.message: Group names must not repeat or match a period name ($1) — a repeated name gets a sequence number.

tabGroups_bookmarks_without_folder.message: A row without a selected folder won't be used.

tabGroups_bookmarks_title_aria.message: Name of the group from bookmarks (empty = folder name)

tabGroups_bookmarks_whole_domain_title.message: The group also gets tabs with other addresses on the domain of any bookmark in the folder: with a bookmark some.tld, e.g. some.tld/folder/file.html. The www. prefix doesn't count (some.tld and www.some.tld are the same domain), other subdomains do.

tabGroups_bookmarks_whole_domain.message: all URLs on the bookmark's domain

tabGroups_bookmarks_color_aria.message: Color of the group from bookmarks

tabGroups_bookmarks_missing_permission.message: Groups from bookmarks need access to bookmarks and tab addresses — without it they aren't used and no folder can be chosen.

tabGroups_bookmarks_permission_here.message: It can't be granted here — allow it in Settings, the popup or the side panel.
